question: Whether the operational TianChu ten-stem table has premodern textual support, and whether the old 'Fullbook competing table' claim is source-bound strongly enough to remain a historical candidate.

controlling_sources.author: 明·萬民英
controlling_sources.heading: 論天厨
controlling_sources.text: 甲乙巳午丙在子，丁戊己午己申儲，庚落寅中辛尋午，壬厨居酉癸居猪。
controlling_sources.gloss: 天厨祿名食神祿；以甲食丙、丙祿在巳，乙食丁、丁祿居午為例。

controlling_sources.note: A modern received transcription of ZhangGuo Xingzong reproduces the same TianChu verse and food-god-lu gloss, but the registered 1594 physical target leaf was not directly reviewed for TianChu in this batch.
